summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") fetches a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the installer's platform/arch, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods +x, and executes the shipped local file math_init.js under that alien runtime via execFileSync. The wrapper setup.mjs itself uses obfuscated identifiers (_0x... hex names) and hex-encoded string dictionaries. The invoked math_init.js is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled artifact consisting of a shuffled string-array with a classic array-rotation decoder (WV8StW pushing/shifting), with no human-readable source shipped alongside. The package advertises itself as a React chat UI, whose functionality does not require a second language runtime or an opaque binary blob to be executed at install time. Downloading a non-Node runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload on every `npm install` is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
